note: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/drivers/adc/adc_mcux_lpadc.c#L487: the Adc sampler thread calls adc_read_dt -> adc_read -> z_impl_adc_read (inline) -> the LPADC driver's read; mcux_lpadc_read_async, mcux_lpadc_start_read and the adc_context inlines are inlined into it (CONFIG_PM_POLICY_DEVICE_CONSTRAINTS unset); the deepest branch is the wait for completion, k_sem_take(&ctx->sync, K_FOREVER), which the LPADC interrupt (isr_lpadc) completes. Off this path by a fact about the caller and two about the configuration: adc_context_start_read's interval branch (adc_context_enable_timer -> k_timer_start -> z_add_timeout) needs a non-NULL sequence->options, and the sampler's sequence has none (adapters/adc/sampler.c); CONFIG_PM_POLICY_DEVICE_CONSTRAINTS=n keeps mcux_lpadc_pm_policy_device_power_lock_get/put out of the read; CONFIG_LOG=n keeps the driver's LOG_ERR callees out. All three are predicates of the row
